findings.explanation: Net 90 payment terms mean you will wait up to three months to get paid for your work, which creates a significant cash flow risk.
Payment is due 90 days after invoicing, which is much longer than the standard 30 days and severely delays your cash flow.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body:
Hi, thank you for sending over the agreement. Before I sign, I would like to request a few adjustments to the terms.

- Regarding the clause "Invoices are payable Net 90.", waiting up to three months to get paid creates a significant cash flow risk, so I propose changing this to: "Invoices are payable Net 30."
- Regarding the clause "Payment period: Net 90", a 90-day payment window severely delays cash flow compared to standard terms, so I propose changing this to: "Payment period: Net 30"

Best regards,
